lines.zh: 我一走一晃，蛋壳晃得很厉害。
lines.en: I waddle along, my eggshell rocking.

lines.zh: 我踩着沼泽的软地慢慢走。
lines.en: I walk slowly over the swamp's soft ground.
My legs are short and my steps are small.

lines.zh: 我一路晃过去，像一只蛋在走。
lines.en: I rock along like an egg that walks.

lines.zh: 我绕过一滩水，怕陷下去。
lines.en: I go around a pool so I do not sink.

lines.zh: 我朝有粪便味道的地方去。
lines.en: I head toward the smell of dung.

lines.zh: 我从盘着的树根间挤过。
lines.en: I squeeze through the coiled roots.
Two steps, one breath.

lines.zh: 我拖着脚，壳上的裂口有声。
lines.en: I shuffle, and the crack in my shell creaks.
I walk toward the trees on your side.
I walk steadily, though slowly.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方草被压平。
lines.en: The grass flattens where I pass.

lines.zh: 我站着，壳里透出一点光。
lines.en: I stand, a little light leaking through my shell.
I scratch my shell with two short arms.
I squat at the swamp's edge.

lines.zh: 我把头缩进壳里又伸出来。
lines.en: I pull my head into the shell and out again.
I listen to the insects in the wood.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地晃了一下身子。
lines.en: I rock my body slowly.
I wait for you to give me something to eat.
There is a crack across my shell.
I sit down, looking rather ridiculous.

lines.zh: 我打了个嗝，壳响了一下。
lines.en: I burp and my shell clinks.
I rub my feet in the mud.
I roll over once by the swamp.
I lean my shell against a trunk.

lines.zh: 我在数树上落下的果子。
lines.en: I count the fruit dropping from the tree.
Are you my master?
I look up at you, very seriously.

lines.zh: 你能把我带出这片沼泽吗？
lines.en: Can you take me out of this swamp?
Is there something to eat?
I lean over and look up at you.
I have that smell of yours.
I am strange, but not bad.
What are you laughing at?
I wobble over toward you.
Could your hand pat me?
I will follow you around.
Wherever you go, I go.
There is a sound in my shell; hear it?
Standing like this tires me.
Slow down; my shell is heavy.

lines.zh: 你别怕，我只是壳有点裂。
lines.en: Don't fear me; my shell is just cracked.
I wobble twice and nearly fall.
Another crack appears on my shell.
I pull half into my shell.
I let out a muffled cry.
I step back into deep mud.
That blow set my shell ringing.

lines.zh: 我壳里的软身子缩了一下。
lines.en: The soft body inside my shell flinches.
That hurt quite a bit.
I hold my belly and rock.
I squat and recover.
Is there dung? I want it.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，闻着不错。
lines.en: That in your hand smells good.
From inside my shell, I shift toward your hand.
Set it down and I will come.
That will feed me a long while.
I swallow, and my shell wobbles.
Is that heap something to eat?

lines.zh: 那堆东西让我壳都晃了。
lines.en: That pile makes my shell wobble.
Just toss it over.
I follow that smell over.
The mud on your boots smells appetizing.
Can I reach that one?

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我晃得快倒了。
lines.en: You bump me and I nearly topple.
I bump your leg, and it is hard.
I bounce off and roll half a turn.
We collide and my shell clinks.

lines.zh: 我扶住你的膝盖站稳了。
lines.en: I hold your knee and steady myself.
You splash and soak me.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，泥里留了坑。
lines.en: I step back and leave a dent in the mud.
I am knocked onto my side.
After we part, I shake my shell.
I cannot hold; I can only step aside.
I came out of an egg.
I need to think about that.
There is something inside my shell.
I turn my head slowly aside.
Do not ask about that.
I rock my body.
Let me eat something first.
I understand none of it.
I squat and give no answer.
I am off to the swamp.
I pick it up and hug it tight.
I grip it with my short arms.
Will this fit in my shell?
I stuff it in and wobble.
This smells like it will go down.
I pick it up; it is a stone.
Holding it, I can hardly walk.
I tuck it under my shell.
I take it up in my mouth.
I push the thing in front of you.
I squint that way.
I am going to follow you.
I have fixed on my master.
That smell on you is good.
I shift two steps toward you.

lines.zh: 你站的那块泥我记住了。
lines.en: I remember the patch of mud you stand on.
I start waddling after you.
I want to see where you go.
I walk toward your back.
You are the one I follow.

lines.zh: 壳缝里的眼睛认出了你。
lines.en: The eye in my shell's crack knows you.
I am following; do not leave me.
I roll after you, shell bobbing.
You take a step; I wobble two.
I wobble along, eyes on you.
You stop and wait for me.
I am slow, but I do not fall behind.
I walk around in your footprints.
You get far and I speed up a little.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的影子慢慢晃。
lines.en: I sway along with your shadow.

lines.zh: 你回头，我正晃在你后面。
lines.en: Look back and I am wobbling behind you.
I follow your scent.

lines.zh: 我顺着你的脚印晃过去。
lines.en: I wobble along in your footprints.
Wait for me; my legs are short.
I butt you with my head.

lines.zh: 我这短手打不疼，可很烦。
lines.en: My short arms do not hurt much, only annoy.
My shell meets your knee.

lines.zh: 撞完我自己也滚了半圈。
lines.en: I roll half over myself after the hit.
I hop and land on you, heavy.
I push you back a step.
That was my whole shell.
After the blow I sit down.
You blocked and my arm slipped.
After striking, I am still wobbling.
I butt you with my shell, solidly.
That nearly tipped me over.
A soft body sits inside my shell.
I push half my shell up out of the mud.
You hear my shell first.

lines.zh: 一只有裂缝的蛋站了起来。
lines.en: A cracked egg stands up.

lines.zh: 我蛋壳上还挂着沼泽的泥。
lines.en: Marsh mud still hangs on my eggshell.
I land in the mud and it sprays.
I shake the mud off my shell.
The insects here go silent.

lines.zh: 我从一摊烂泥里滚出来。
lines.en: I roll out of a patch of muck.
I wobble first before standing.
I raise my head to look at this swamp.

lines.zh: 我带着一身泥出现在你面前。
lines.en: I appear before you covered in mud.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的壳发烫，我跳起来。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell and I hop about.
I fall and land shell-up.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我在泥里乱蹬。
lines.en: Water pours in and I kick wildly in the mud.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，蛋滚出去。
lines.en: The blast rolls me away like an egg.

lines.zh: 箭尖在壳面划出一道白痕。
lines.en: The arrowhead leaves a white scratch on my shell.

lines.zh: 法术一过，我的壳变热了。
lines.en: A spell passes and my shell grows hot.
With nothing to eat, I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷打我身上，我整个亮了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I light up all over.

lines.zh: 虚空拉我，我在泥里抓不住东西。
lines.en: The void pulls and I find no grip in the mud.
